blocks.text: Annabelle Rama and Sarah Lahbati, estranged wife of the talent manager’s son Richard Gutierrez, have already sorted out their differences. This was according to Rama’s daughter Ruffa Gutierrez, who said that the reconciliation took place at the wake of her other sister-in-law, Alexa Uichico, wife of her younger brother Elvis, who died of leukemia in July 2024.
